snippet.title: Before the Silence // Announcement Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3875110/Before_the_Silence/

In this turn-based strategy, you will take control of an anti-disinformation department and protect your citizens from terrorist influence. Manage your agents and resources, analyze media, and restore order in different regions of your country.

Developed by 
Left Bank Interactive aka @LeftBankInteractive
